repair_intent.intent_description: Teach Genie the top-N by-metric pattern using sales.fact_sales.revenue grouped by sales.fact_sales.region
repair_intent.rationale: cluster blames missing LIMIT/ORDER BY on revenue

patch_body.example_question: What are the top 3 regions by total revenue this quarter?
patch_body.example_sql: SELECT region, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM sales.fact_sales WHERE order_date >= DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY region ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 3
patch_body.usage_guidance: Use when the user asks for top-N entities ranked by a metric.

per_qid_evidence.observed_failure: returned 1 row instead of top 3 by revenue
per_qid_evidence.generated_sql_issue: missing LIMIT 3 and ORDER BY revenue DESC
per_qid_evidence.expected_sql_shape: GROUP BY region ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3

per_qid_evidence.observed_failure: returned all regions instead of top 5
per_qid_evidence.expected_sql_shape: GROUP BY region ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

result.rationale: example_sql cleanly demonstrates top-N pattern using blame_set columns sales.fact_sales.revenue + region; example_question is a concrete top-N ask; gs_044/gs_055 unaffected (no top-N in their ask shape).
